stance: Measurement economics is formalizing granular accounting frameworks that separate autonomous scraping from delegated, user-prompted agent actions.
adoption_shape: Infrastructure monitors like Cloudflare Radar and the Known Agents directory have aligned on categorizing delegated agents alongside autonomous crawlers, even as platforms like Google maintain legacy identifiers like Google-NotebookLM concurrently with new ones like Google-GeminiNotebook.
new_entrants: Recent entries including MiniMaxAgent, Diffbot-User, Haiku-SearchBot, Liner-User, and Google-GeminiNotebook have entered tracking registries to stake out footprints for browser-based task execution and user-prompted assistant fetching.
watch_for: The integration and adoption of Web Bot Auth verification status and content usage classifications across Cloudflare Radar's newly indexed agents.
